reward_terms.name: approach_progress
reward_terms.formula: Potential decrease of wrist and opposing-pad pose error before grasp

reward_terms.name: opposition
reward_terms.formula: One-time qualifying thumb and opposing-contact grasp At most once per episode across retries.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Increased unsupported centre rise while opposed, capped at 35 mm Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: Opposed lift above 15 mm for 0.10 s At most once per episode across retries.

reward_terms.name: reference_progress
reward_terms.formula: Sequential per-episode demonstration pose waypoints, opposed with active fingers Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: wrist_reference
reward_terms.formula: Palm position and orientation potential toward the selected reference

reward_terms.name: active_rotation
reward_terms.formula: Pay for episode-best combined blade elevation and relative rotation while unsupported, opposed and actively moving the fingers.

reward_terms.name: passive_rotation
reward_terms.formula: Variation of relative orientation under opposed contact with nearly stationary fingers

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: Completes at least 50 degrees of wrist-relative turn while opposed with blades within 20 degrees of up At most once per episode across retries.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in left-goal distance weighted by blade elevation under opposed contact Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: place_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in upright standing-height and blade-axis errors inside goal with hand contact Also guide the centre toward the target XY. Carry advances to descent at least 15 mm inside the zone. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: support_transfer
reward_terms.formula: First table support with hand contact following the turn and carried goal entry At most once per episode across retries. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: After controlled support transfer, stable upright table support with hand contact released At most once per episode across retries. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: durable_goal
reward_terms.formula: Maintains terminal goal for 0.5 s, penalty for subsequent disturbance Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Loses the opposed airborne plug before support Also penalize and reset the grasp attempt if the transport returns to support before entry or loses opposition for two steps.

reward_terms.name: time_and_control
reward_terms.formula: Living cost, small action term, hand/table cost, and safety penalty

reward_terms.name: leftward_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed decrease in distance to goal y during opposed unsupported turn and carry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: settling_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in object speed during supported hand contact following carried entry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: hand_clearance
reward_terms.formula: Increase in distance from the nearest pad after supported release. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: recontact
reward_terms.formula: Hand recontacts the supported upright plug following the first opening.

reward_terms.name: terminal_goal
reward_terms.formula: At the training horizon, the released plug still meets the resting goal over the last 0.5 s. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: load_transfer_progress
reward_terms.formula: Pay episode-best progress in an upright handover inside the zone and within 65 mm of standing height while touching the plug. The potential multiplies upright alignment by 0.35 standing-height progress, 0.25 low object velocity and spin, and 0.40 vertical table load saturated at 0.85 plug weights.

reward_terms.name: quiet_loaded_support
reward_terms.formula: One bonus after two consecutive 30 Hz samples with continuous table support, hand contact, tilt <= 15 degrees, speed < 0.06 m/s, spin < 1.5 rad/s, and vertical load >= 0.55 plug weights.

body.text: Expose only the signed difference between delayed, filtered finger targets and measured joint angles as 20 new actor inputs. In the v3 r0285 retained traces, the norm on thumb, index and middle at occluded in-zone samples has medians 0.429 rad airborne opposed, 0.246 rad supported with contact and 0.079 rad table alone. The raw target difference for table alone is 0.364 rad. Aggregate v2 and r0293 traces show broadly the same separation. This observation transform uses prior contract targets and encoders only, starts at the measured hand, and adds zero-padded input weights and optimizer moments. The audit uses true contacts to label retrospective distributions only. No diagnostic labels, inferred contact flag, extra observations, actions, copied weights or clock enter the policy. Plan a 24M-step PPO continuation after the current branch budget to test clean release under camera loss.

body.reflection: Support-load training in v2 reaches 47 staged releases and 46 ordered placements, including 23 exact clean completions across 64 starts. There are 34 measured hardware violation episodes, one torque stop and one state-log arm-limit error. This candidate is the strongest full-task development checkpoint so far, with substantial physical violations. Check the same export independently in simulation v3.

body.text: The proposed 1 ms model with firm unilateral finger limits passes outcome parity on 128 independent fixed-plan replays after screening the plan on 16 disjoint training draws. CPU scores 22/128 and Warp 16/128, with zero hardware violations and drops on both. On 32 local 60 s starts, the original feasibility search has seven exact completions and mostly fails the 65-degree wrist criterion or support transfer. Test a finite expansion with smaller wrist turns and modest supported height shifts. These privileged plans are reserved for feasibility, and will not provide PPO action targets. Simulation v3 remains active until the new model is documented and proves feasibility.

Use r0302 as the common PPO parent for two v3 continuations. It reaches 23 exact v2 completions at 144.83M, versus 21 at 147.85M and zero after its completed 25M budget. Both new trials keep the parent support-load reward, placement reset mix and PPO settings. One learns with a measured-palm rotation action map, bounded to 0.26 rad before a 0.08 rad target-change limit. In r0297, 60/64 traces left the unreachable-orientation tracking bound with the integrated target map. A 450-observation NumPy/Torch test confirmed equivalent bounded outputs. The other adds the r0299 encoder residual, verified across 1,000 paired samples with maximum difference 1.14e-6 and a contract-v3 smoke p99 of 0.984 ms. Give each 24M PPO steps, score every 3M in v3 and compare stage rates, stop reasons and full replay errors against the direct r0302 replay. Neither change is selected or deployed before a gate.

body.text: The v2 load checkpoint r0302 has 34 measured hardware violations on 64 starts. All 34 are finger excursions beyond 0.02 rad, median 0.02871 and maximum 0.04369 rad, with no arm excursion beyond 0.05 rad. In the v3 r0301 replay, six finger excursions have median 0.02374 and maximum 0.03167 rad. The 1 ms model is still a candidate. Audit first contact and commanded joint position at these excursions to determine whether a learned target margin or collision avoidance is more relevant.

body.text: The r0312 actor replay in the 1 ms diagnostic model now gives 22 of 64 exact clean completions and zero measured finger-limit violations. Registered v3 gives 17 and six respectively on the same starts. The 1 ms comparison has two arm-collision stops and five state-log tracking errors. A separate untrained 0.025 rad target-margin counterfactual on 16 conditioned v3 starts reduces six selected finger excursions to two, but full-sequence completion changes from ten selected nominal successes to two nominal or one contract-clean. This margin alone is unsuitable for adoption. The physical joint-limit comparison is independent of the target decoder and retains the direct v3 action map.

simulator.name: MuJoCo
simulator.gpu_backend: MuJoCo Warp GPU solver with matched model and commands, using float32 dynamics.

scene.model: Full provided Marvin Wuji MJCF, both arms/hands and original collision geometry, with a single plug, table, floor, and column.

plug.state_frame: Housing centre, +Z toward blade tips, +Y across the blade gap. Identity object/body frame.
plug.geometry: Station housing and two blade OBJ parts from given/recon. Exact specified dimensions and axes.
plug.physical_prior: The comparable charger teardown weighs 58.5 g. The video supports the housing geometry and grasp scale, with no force data. Used the operator 60 g estimate and housing-plus-blades bounding-box inertia. Contact pair assumptions are 0.40 sliding at the table, 0.80 hand material friction. The PC-glass study is a material prior and its interface differs from the station. The video shows little post-release slide but does not identify either coefficient.
plug.contact: Housing and two blades have separate convex collision meshes. Elliptic sliding and torsional contact, solref 0.012 s / damping ratio 1, solimp [0.93,0.98,0.001].

reference.method: White cycle with d2s_reference progress, object start and goal alignment and SLERP. Palm axis mapping is derived from reconstructed MANO joints. Applying a world-up yaw adjustment of 150 degrees to the wrist and its offset selects a more reachable approach heading while keeping plug start and goal constraints. The palm height is projected above -0.225 m in the retarget. These embodiment adjustments guide rewards and are not executed trajectories.

body.arm: Published 100 Hz palm clamp and jump stop, measured-seed DLS IK with the 5 degree ranges, delayed 100 Hz joint reference and velocity, and the provided arm capsules. The position actuator receives q_ref + (D/K) q_ref_dot so velocity tracking effort is counted inside each motor's effort cap. Compensate modeled bias minus gravity compensation separately. Use only contact EFC rows for the right arm or hand against table, plug, column or parked arm to estimate external torque with J transpose f. The existing 30 ms estimated torque filter and 20 Nm halt operate on that signal.
body.hand: Public geometry and deployed limits including the 1 mm glove collision margin. Finger targets have 35 ms delay and 2 Hz low pass. Internal position gains are 12x vendor kp and 3x vendor kv as a response approximation with current-limited torque. Nominal evaluation uses 0.6x joint effort, with 0.1 deg encoder noise. The deployed finger ranges remain fixed. A 2 ms unilateral joint-limit time constant at 1 ms physics integration reduces numerical penetration through the range. The 100 Hz filter and existing proprioceptive delays are unchanged.
body.sensor: Default d2s_sensor.PoseSensor fed at 60 Hz. 48 surface samples from the complete object mesh, visual points clipped by calibrated ego-camera geometry. Arm caps and fitted capsules for hand-link mesh occluders. Proprioception delayed by a lognormal draw quantized to the nearest 60 Hz row.

initial_conditions.object: Uniform independent x/y offsets ±10 mm and blade yaw ±10 degrees about -90 degrees, X-up on the supported face.
initial_conditions.start_check: Hold controller uses the reset palm so the entire hold check, including any ramp rows, can test a stationary hand. Candidate evaluation simulates the actual package start ramp.

cpu_gpu_outcome_parity.criterion: Outcome parity (same policy, both backends, >= min-seeds seeds, scored by the evaluator's judge) is the criterion that counts. State-level and replay checks are diagnostics.

validation.design: Fixed plan 20 screened on 16 independent training seeds. Replay its 30 Hz targets with 60 Hz state sampling on the two matched physics backends across another 128 13 s starts. Full deployment and state checks are separate.
limitations: The finer-step model still shows exceptional physical limit excursions and arm pose tracking errors.
The 32.8 mm ramp lag is above the robot example range 18–25 mm.
Mass, friction, glove compliance and torque filtering remain station estimates.
Kinematic replay is visualization only. The nominal and randomized data remain distinct.

body.limitations: Simulation covers only the deployed white plug. Replay follows reconstructed wrist and object poses with a visualization aperture and has up to 3.75 mm nominal overlap. Measured finger excursions can still appear at contact and commanded limits. CPU and GPU individual contact outcomes differ. This is a simulation claim.

revision.cause: In r0287 the task gate rejects a measured hand limit excursion. The registered v3 stress audit finds violations on 13/24 starts, with no arm-limit excursion. Fine integration and stiffer unilateral joint constraints better enforce the specified deployed finger ranges without modifying encoder observations.
revision.implementation: Reduce physics step from 2 ms to 1 ms and change only the 20 deployed finger limit solver time constants to 2 ms. The 100 Hz arm and hand controllers, 60 Hz sensor samples, 30 Hz policy rate and all ranges, stops, object, arm and criteria stay the same. Reproduce the substep timing in MuJoCo Warp.

gpu_backend.physics: Full geometry MuJoCo Warp 3.17 with the motor-limited arm and exactly timed 1 ms physics substeps over the 100 Hz controls and 60 Hz samples.
gpu_backend.limitations: The 128-start finite-plan comparison passes outcome parity. Arithmetic, proprioception, pose randomness and contact sequences can still yield different episodes.

gate_evidence.seen: r0271: seeds 1693345725 and 484050708 hold the white plug through support and stand blades up after opening, while seeds 1101195590 and 1564294741 stand upright but fail on excessive passive roll. Preserve those transfer checks. In the subsequent r0287 state logs, finger encoders exceed deployed limits. The 1 ms model reduces measured excursions on matched stresses and preserves physical transfer without changed criteria.

body.hypothesis: Measure a running task baseline under the registered motor-limited model while training controlled support transfer. The earlier v2 incumbent attains 62 of 64 turns in the v3 development replay, with zero measured hardware violations or state check errors and one arm collision stop.
body.observed: The r0271 feasibility failure montages for seeds 1101195590 and 1564294741 reach an upright hands-off plug but exceed the 25-degree passive-roll limit. The r0287 task attempt produced no montage after a finger encoder excursion, motivating a clean baseline.
body.success_rule: every stage, hardware within limits, no stop
body.reason: first gate of this suite version: the baseline, now the incumbent

body.text: Closed-loop r0302 parity in registered simulation v3 on 128 independent draws passes the outcome comparison. CPU has 50 physical full-sequence successes and 48 hardware-violation episodes, while Warp has 52 and 52. CPU-only and GPU-only successes number 32 and 34, respectively. Nominal rates match within the declared statistical tolerance, with substantial trajectory-level discord. This comparison uses the same deterministic PPO actor and each backend sensor, with physical stage and stop checks. Full contract replay evidence remains the deployed CPU suite.

body.pass_rate_reason: The required mastery threshold across full deployment starts with independent sensor perturbations.
body.description: From the station's right-side start, lift in opposition, turn with finger motion, carry left and release blades up under contract v3.
body.reason: Use simulation v4 with 1 ms integration and firmer deployed finger-limit constraints. Matched full-start stress checks show fewer finger excursions. Preserve the frozen task criteria, start distribution and contract-v3 checks.
body.gate_evidence: r0317: seeds 1485522513 and 2102844593 continue holding and tipping the plug from 2.30 through 56.20 s with no supported release. The baseline also flags one fresh hardware violation. Preserve the carry-to-support requirement, and check the new physical model before using task results.

body.pass_rate_reason: The required threshold for a physical feasibility demonstration over the complete deployment distribution.
body.description: Same environment, start distribution and motion predicates as task, using a privileged feasibility controller.
body.reason: Prove feasibility of the finer-step station using the same task criteria and nominal deployment starts before PPO or task gates in simulation v4.
body.gate_evidence: r0271: the two successful montages show opposed transport into sustained supported opening, and both failed montages stand the plug upright while their measured passive turns exceed 25 degrees. This manipulation remains the v4 feasibility demonstration.
body.warning: suite task_feasibility version 3's incumbent r0271 meets its pass rate (success 25/32 = 0.781 >= 0.25). Version 4 starts over: its first gate is a new baseline, and the suite loses its standing until version 4's incumbent meets its pass rate (another suite of the link that meets its own still counts). Tightening your own criteria resets what you have proven; do it only for a reason the demonstration or the task gives, and say it in --reason (demo2sim/VERIFICATION.md section 3).

Seeds 1485522513 and 2102844593 end at y = -0.1856 m and -0.1982 m, short of the goal front at -0.10 m. The snapshots show the plug held at each displayed time, while the continuous logs count about 26 seconds of held time overall. Seed 887427367 also reaches a 0.02311 rad finger excursion. Keep the same success criteria in v4.

body.reflection: Matched v3 PPO at 141.85M reaches 61 turns and 21 staged placements, with eight contract-clean exact completions. Thirty-eight measured violation episodes, 35 rejected contract state logs and ten stops remain. Mature grip and release can survive the dynamics change, but the physical and arm-tracking stability is insufficient.

body.text: Sampling audit for r0302 under motor-limited simulation v3. Across the same 64 starts, deterministic randomized inference gives 21 physical full-sequence completions. The trained stochastic policy gives one, and Gaussian caps of 0.35 and 0.22 give two each. The audit also measures an older permissive reward proxy, whose 60 s counts rise from 36 to 39 and 47 under the caps. That proxy differs from r0302 training. These short comparisons do not justify a noise-only change. The v4 strict-transfer reward dry check gives mean 46.47 on finite physical plans, versus -0.790 hold and -0.907 random. It yields 14 training-terminal proxies and no plan violations on 38 matched starts.

Continue the assigned comparison and measure recovery before choosing a candidate.

body.text: Among retained continuous-transfer traces, the r0324 actor first takes table support at median 3.05 s and opens at 3.38 s. The first encoder-response checkpoint r0332 opens at 3.53 s and holds table support for median 0.46 s. These retained subsets include endpoint matches and are not population frequencies. Some hardware excursions first occur after 40 s. Preserve the full 60 s deployment check and test post-release control separately from early grip and transfer changes.

body.hypothesis: The 1 ms simulation with firmer unilateral finger limits preserves intentional manipulation. The existing finite privileged bank gains variants with smaller wrist turns and modest supported-height shifts, reaching 28 of 32 exact local sequences with zero violations. Test on fresh deployment draws.
body.observed: In r0317 seeds 1485522513 and 2102844593 continue holding and tipping the plug through 56.20 s. The v3 feasibility successes in r0271 show sustained table contact through opening, and its failures exceed 25 degrees of passive turn. The expanded feasibility controller targets the same supported release and in-hand roll.

body.text: The fresh v4 feasibility gate r0337 passes with 26/32 full sequences, 32 turns and zero hardware violations. Both failure montages, 118019605 and 322616849, stand the plug blades-up with hands clear by 17.70 s but miss the continuous carry-release stage. Both success montages show supported opening and roughly 50 s of hands-off rest. Begin matched v4 PPO from r0302, the r0324 checkpoint with 35 clean v3 completions. Retain its reward, placement reset distribution, action/observation map, ensemble-free architecture and optimizer. Give the adaptation 24M steps with 3M checkpoints. The strict reward dry audit scores 46.47 for physical plans, -0.790 hold and -0.907 random. The physical stage metrics and full state replay remain the selection evidence.

Both achieve carried entry and first support at 9.133 s, then lose support before opening at 9.550 s and 9.267 s. Both finish upright with hands clear, as in the montages. Run its first v4 task gate to establish a fresh-start baseline.

body.text: The v3 pose-memory adaptation has reached its 18M-step budget. Use GPU 1 for a 24M-step matched asymmetric-critic comparison under proven v4, with the same r0302 parent, rewards, start distributions, action map, initialization, and optimizer as r0338. Add 38 inputs only to the PPO value network, covering true object pose and velocities, finger and support contact, reward phase and remaining training horizon. Zero-pad critic weights and Adam moments. Holding a plug under camera loss can hide value differences between carry and support. This comparison tests whether a better informed training critic improves full carry-release sequences and hardware stability while the deployed actor continues to use the same contract history. See Learning Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation, section 4.1, https://arxiv.org/html/1808.00177v5. Record the trial as privileged and export the single deployable actor only.

body.observed: In the r0337 failed montages seeds 118019605 and 322616849 end upright with hands clear. Matched trace replay shows first support at 9.133 s and support lost before opening at 9.550 s and 9.267 s. Score the complete support handover instead of the endpoint alone.

body.reason: first gate of this suite version: the baseline, now the incumbent

body.text: In five identical-seed reruns of the physical faults of r0348, the first crossing is index PIP at 3.619–3.638 s during opening. Its filtered target is -0.349 rad and deployed lower stop is -0.350 rad, with measured crossing velocities -25.74 to -27.45 rad/s. Four traces show middle fingertip contact with the table at the crossing. On a conditioned set of those five and eleven clean starts, an untrained index-only 0.025 rad command margin gives 12 exact sequences and three physical violations, including two new violations. The 0.045 rad margin gives ten and three. The outcome depends on contact transitions. Keep the current evaluated policy as the candidate and test a PPO reward for limit margin after reviewing its fresh gate. Preserve the delivered joint ranges and all checks.

body.text: Allocate 24M v4 PPO steps to the finger-only limit-margin reward after the encoder-response budget finishes. The r0350 gate montages show upright hands-off endpoints in the two transfer failures, and r0351 isolates five measured index PIP excursions during rapid opening. Keep r0338 initial actor, base reward, curriculum, observation and action map. Add a small penalty for fast joint motion toward a deployed limit or measured excursion, with a one-time violation loss at termination. A matched v4 dry check scores 42.32 for the 38 physical plan replays, -0.790 hold and -0.913 random, with zero finger-margin cost on the plans. Predict fewer physical violations while preserving continuous support, and compare three-dimensional replay and measured results before adopting.

Local evaluation retains selected success and failure raw traces after scoring and replay-checking every full start. Complete per-seed contract and outcome JSON remains durable. In an eight-start v4 recheck, every contract and result row matches the earlier archive exactly while retaining five raw traces. The official gate evaluator, episode duration, judged evidence and earlier archives stay frozen.

body.reflection: First matched v4 adaptation checkpoint from r0302. There are 62 lifts, 61 turns and five nominal placements, with four clean full sequences across 64 starts. No measured violations or stops, two contract errors. Fine-step retraining initially loses the strong direct transfer rate, so keep the declared budget and monitor later recovery.

body.text: All nine r0348 transfer misses on the fixed development set contain one 60 Hz sample without table support after touchdown and before qualified opening. Seven retain hand contact and seven have downward centre velocity at the gap. The plug is 0.048–1.077 mm above standing height. On retained traces, the median supported-window mean absolute vertical speed is 0.0132 m/s for 52 completed transfers and 0.0185 m/s for the nine interruptions. The r0350 montages show upright, hands-clear endpoints even when the transfer fails. Test a single PPO reward term for vertical plug speed above 0.018 m/s, within 18 mm of standing height and inside the goal during a controlled transfer, with maximum cost 0.04 per policy step. Dry v4 return is 43.22 for physical plans, -0.790 hold and -0.907 random, with mean added physical cost -0.050. Allocate 24M steps from r0302 after the measured-wrist budget finishes. Keep all other r0338 settings and the frozen verification criteria.

The new v4 sampling diagnostic replaced the strict 60 Hz reward tracker with its trace recorder, so the uncorrected training-proxy column is invalid. Its 42/64 physical completions under randomized deterministic inference came from the actual closed-loop trace. The capture callback now calls the existing tracker as well as recording. Rerun the diagnostic in a separate archive. PPO training has its own tracker without this diagnostic observer, and gate measurements are independent.

Use public hand forward kinematics to express observed encoders as five pad positions in the palm frame and five table heights. In 833 observed samples around support in the v4 transfer audit the camera estimate is invalid on all samples. Encoder-derived pad heights differ from instantaneous simulator geometry by median 0.68 mm and p95 3.3–3.6 mm. This supplies near-table context during camera loss and is not a contact flag. The transforms match MuJoCo at 1,280 test pad centres and NumPy and Torch agree within 9.54e-7 on normalized features. A small PPO smoke export with the new 20 columns passes contract v3 with p99 1.052 ms. The input uses only measured palm pose, hand angles and fixed public geometry. Keep the active controlled comparisons, and consider this observation change if support remains the main failure.

architecture.actor: 2 hidden SiLU layers with 26 Gaussian action means; mean inference
architecture.finger_action: Previous finger targets plus .093 rad bounded increments.
architecture.observation_anchor: Last valid camera estimate in the palm frame nearest image time, and subsequent proprioceptive finger displacement. Use preceding policy observation to approximate alignment. Carry this feature across camera loss, and clear it at reset.
architecture.continuation: When adding the 33 anchor inputs, extend both PPO first layers with zero weights, preserving the initial actor's behavior. Start the optimizer for the expanded shapes with no moments.
architecture.hand_response_inputs: 20 signed differences between a delayed 2 Hz low-pass of past finger targets and the observed encoders, divided by 0.20 rad and clipped to [-4, 4]. Start from the measured positions at each reset. Extend the first layers and their optimizer moments with zeros.

reward_terms.name: opposition

reward_terms.name: lift_progress

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: Opposed lift above 15 mm for 0.10 s At most once per episode across retries.

reward_terms.name: reference_progress
reward_terms.formula: Sequential per-episode demonstration pose waypoints, opposed with active fingers Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: wrist_reference
reward_terms.formula: Palm position and orientation potential toward the selected reference

reward_terms.name: active_rotation
reward_terms.formula: Pay for episode-best combined blade elevation and relative rotation while unsupported, opposed and actively moving the fingers.

reward_terms.name: passive_rotation
reward_terms.formula: Variation of relative orientation under opposed contact with nearly stationary fingers

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: Completes at least 50 degrees of wrist-relative turn while opposed with blades within 20 degrees of up At most once per episode across retries.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in left-goal distance weighted by blade elevation under opposed contact Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: place_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in upright standing-height and blade-axis errors inside goal with hand contact Also guide the centre toward the target XY. Carry advances to descent at least 15 mm inside the zone. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: support_transfer
reward_terms.formula: First table support with hand contact following the turn and carried goal entry At most once per episode across retries. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: After controlled support transfer, stable upright table support with hand contact released At most once per episode across retries. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: durable_goal
reward_terms.formula: Maintains terminal goal for 0.5 s, penalty for subsequent disturbance Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Loses the opposed airborne plug before support Also penalize and reset the grasp attempt if the transport returns to support before entry or loses opposition for two steps.

reward_terms.name: time_and_control
reward_terms.formula: Living cost, small action term, hand/table cost, and safety penalty

reward_terms.name: leftward_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed decrease in distance to goal y during opposed unsupported turn and carry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: settling_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in object speed during supported hand contact following carried entry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: hand_clearance
reward_terms.formula: Increase in distance from the nearest pad after supported release. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: recontact
reward_terms.formula: Hand recontacts the supported upright plug following the first opening.

reward_terms.name: terminal_goal
reward_terms.formula: At the training horizon, the released plug still meets the resting goal over the last 0.5 s. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: load_transfer_progress
reward_terms.formula: Pay episode-best progress in an upright handover inside the zone and within 65 mm of standing height while touching the plug. The potential multiplies upright alignment by 0.35 standing-height progress, 0.25 low object velocity and spin, and 0.40 vertical table load saturated at 0.85 plug weights.

reward_terms.name: quiet_loaded_support
reward_terms.formula: One bonus after two consecutive 30 Hz samples with continuous table support, hand contact, tilt <= 15 degrees, speed < 0.06 m/s, spin < 1.5 rad/s, and vertical load >= 0.55 plug weights.

body.reflection: The v4 asymmetric-critic checkpoint at 153.94M reaches 22 exact full sequences, 64 lifts and 61 turns. All 64 state logs pass, with no physical violations or stops. This is a clean improvement from its first checkpoint.

body.text: The later asymmetric-critic checkpoint r0381 reaches 55/64 exact full completions, 63 staged placements, one measured finger violation and seven contract state-log errors. All seven tracking errors occur late, after 36 s. In retained traces the maximum commanded wrist lead through the first five seconds is 0.222 rad. The selected late-error traces reach 0.454 and 0.532 rad. A 0.35 rad lead counterfactual restores all seven tracking checks and completes 15 of 16 conditioned starts, with the same physical limit excursion. Its first crossing is middle PIP at 3.442 s, -0.37105 rad position and -22.13 rad/s velocity, while the filtered target is -0.195 rad inside the range. The output bound warrants a trained action-map comparison. Continue the improving asymmetric branch to its budget and inspect its new exact exports first.

body.reflection: At about 160M the asymmetric-critic checkpoint reaches 64 lifts and turns, 57 ordered placements, nine measured hardware violations and two stops. The exact completion and state replay scores trail the prior r0381 peak.

body.text: The 0.35 rad wrist-lead diagnostic for r0381 preserves 63 staged placements on all 64 matched starts, with 62 contract-clean exact sequences, no state-log errors and the same single middle PIP excursion. This isolates a later wrist-tracking problem without shifting the early transfer result on those starts. The corrected strict-reward sampling audit of r0302 in v4 gives 30/64 physical completions for randomized deterministic inference, four with its trained Gaussian, seven with cap 0.12 and 19 with cap 0.085. Exact physical and strict reward event counts now closely agree. Reserve the lower-noise setting for an explicit PPO comparison, rather than changing the output of the current incumbent.

Queue a six-million-step PPO refinement of r0381 after the matched v4 baseline spends its budget. The latest task gate r0350 shows upright endpoints after unqualified transfers. The r0381 actor already retains 63/64 staged placements. Its 0.35 rad lead diagnostic corrects the late state-log errors, and one early physical middle PIP excursion remains. Combine the bounded wrist command with the finger-limit reward tested independently in r0358. Use a 0.00006 learning rate and 0.085 Gaussian cap so early updates stay closer to the established action distribution. The lower-noise r0388 diagnostic preserves more full stochastic trajectories. This trial bundles the action, reward and PPO settings to test whether the mature transfer can survive safety refinement. Maintain r0381 asymmetric critic, sensor, curriculum, start pose and simulator. Score 1.5M-step exports and inspect PPO KL before extending.

reward_terms.name: turn

reward_terms.name: release

reward_terms.name: recontact

reward_terms.name: terminal_goal

body.text: The r0403 paired gate rejects the r0393 asymmetric-critic checkpoint despite 83 of 96 exact successes and zero hardware violations. The incumbent has 74 of 96 and five violations on those draws. Candidate-only and incumbent-only successes are 20 and 11, yielding one-sided p = 0.0748 at alpha 0.05. In the reviewed failure montage at seed 567495444 the plug is already separated from the hand around 2.30 s and remains on its side at 10 s before later retry motion. Both success montages show the plug upright and hands-off through the final views. Select the distinct matched v4 PPO checkpoint r0402 next. It has 118/128 exact completions across two disjoint development sets, zero violations, zero stops and zero state errors.

body.reflection: Independent fixed-start v4 evidence for the matched r0402 PPO actor. There are 60/64 exact clean sequences and zero hardware violations, stops, or contract state errors. The original set has 58/64 clean. The same actor totals 118/128 exact across the two development sets.

body.text: The matched v4 continuation used its prespecified 24M steps. The 166.03M actor completes 118/128 disjoint development starts without measured violations, stops or state-log errors, then the terminal export drops to 50/64 on the original set. Three retained 166.03M failures lose table support one 60 Hz interval before release qualification, one loses uprightness, and one misses the active turn. The latest gate r0403 also shows seed 567495444 with the plug down and apart from the hand before later retries. Reserve 6M further PPO steps from the 166.03M snapshot at learning rate 0.00006, changing only this rate and export frequency. Predict retention of early acquisition with more consistent supported placement, measured on full contract episodes every 1.5M steps.

architecture.wrist_target_lead_rule: Project the neural rotation target toward a ball around the observed palm. Limit each correction to 0.08 rad relative to the previous target.

reward_terms.name: finger_limit_margin
reward_terms.formula: Penalize measured finger excursion beyond 5 mrad outside the deployed range or rapid motion above 5 rad/s toward a limit within 35 mrad. Add -4 at a violation.

reward_terms.formula: One bonus after two consecutive 30 Hz samples with continuous table support, hand contact, tilt <= 15 degrees, speed < 0.06 m/s, spin < 1.5 rad/s, and vertical load >= 0.55 plug weights.

body.hypothesis: Continue the incumbent training lineage in registered v4 while preserving the deployable-input critic, support-load reward and action map. This checkpoint completes 118 of 128 full development starts across disjoint sets, with zero measured hardware violations, stops or contract replay errors. Test the observed gain on fresh paired starts.
body.observed: In r0403 seed 567495444 the plug sits apart from the gripper around 2.30 s and remains on its side at 10 s before later retries. This episode misses lift. Both successful r0403 montages show the plug upright and hands clear by 10 s.

body.reason: 'success' better on the same seeds: 8 episodes only the candidate completes vs 1 only the incumbent (sign test p = 0.0195 <= 0.05); no stage significantly worse; hardware violations 0 vs 4

body.text: Select the unmodified 166.03M actor from r0402 for independent final verification. Gate r0416 accepts it with 30/32 fresh starts against 23/32 on the paired incumbent, p=0.0195, zero violations and zero stops. I reviewed both failure and both success montages. All four have cleared the hand by 10 s with the plug upright. The two failure rows miss carry_release despite about 56.5 s of upright, supported rest, so endpoint appearance alone cannot qualify. Their role in the failure funnel is confirmed by the gate measurements. Package identity is frozen for the final gate.

reward_terms.name: finger_limit_margin

limitations: This verdict covers the single white deployment plug in simulation.
Grip torque, plug mass, and glove and table friction are estimated.
Contact dynamics and mechanical limit response are approximate. The contract replay checks the logged motion.
The active finger-motion predicate measures finger motion associated with wrist-relative turn.
The v4 ramp end lag is about 33 mm in simulation. The public hardware specification gives 18 to 25 mm as typical.
The selected policy can continue moving the arm after the plug is placed and clear of the hand.
The demonstration's reconstructed airborne rise is about 25 mm. The policy meets the minimum-rise criterion on successes and uses a distinctly higher path.
The harness reference environment runs a separate report-only dynamics cross-check. The physical robot has no target rounds in this run.

stage_checks.lift: Above-table thumb opposition, unloaded from the table for at least 0.10 s, with at least 10 mm rise.
stage_checks.turn: At least 50 degrees wrist-relative turn and 35 degrees of active finger-motion proxy. Wrist excursion at most 65 degrees, passive rotation at most 25 degrees, and blades within 20 degrees of up.
stage_checks.carry_release: Same opposed grasp crosses the zone boundary airborne after at least 0.15 m of leftward motion. An upright, supported transfer must stay continuous through the opening. The evaluator records this ordered test as a stage result.
stage_checks.placed: Zone, orientation, height, speed, support and hand clearance within the frozen limits over the final 0.5 s.

body.reflection: The normal-speed branch at 162.99M places on 43 of 64 starts before complete contract checks. It has one exact completion, nine measured violations, 14 stops and 63 state-log errors. These measured faults rule out this checkpoint.

body.text: Final gate r0424 yields 59/64 exact, no stops and replay p99 0.930 ms. Episode 704533316 completes all task stages but reaches 0.02281 rad finger-limit excursion against the 0.020 rad limit. r0425 records failed self-verification. The report-only harness environment has 45/64 upright placements accompanied by measured hardware violations and zero clean successes. I reviewed the two final failure montages and two successes. Seeds 1518508316 and 290832969 show the carried plug near the grip at 2.3 s and stand clear by 10 s, but their measured carry_release stage fails. I will preserve the unchanged v4 evaluator and compare finger target margin and finger-limit reward independently against the existing 0.00006 learning-rate continuation from r0402. Give each 6M active steps and measure joint excursion tails and ordered success on full independent development starts. Final gate seeds remain diagnostic only.

The r0408 smaller-rate comparison's first export completes 55/64 exact with no measured hardware violations, stops or contract errors. Its 166.03M parent is already highly successful at deterministic mean inference. The earlier r0388 controlled v4 sampling audit increased exact physical completions from four to nineteen of 64 when capping the exploration standard deviation at 0.085. After the r0365 budget, allocate 6M matched continuation steps at learning rate 0.00006 on GPU 0 with only the 0.085 cap added. Predict better stochastic experience at support transfer and measurable gains in deterministic exact success with low measured finger excursions.

architecture.actor_observations: Contract v3 and the actor's own observation history.
architecture.critic_observations: Actor features plus 38 training-only features covering true object pose and velocity, contacts, reward phase, rotation progress and remaining rollout horizon. The critic is omitted from the exported package.
architecture.critic_adaptation: Pad the PPO critic's first layer and Adam moments with zeros on the new columns.
architecture.observation_anchor: Last valid camera estimate in the palm frame nearest image time, and subsequent proprioceptive finger displacement. Use preceding policy observation to approximate alignment. Carry this feature across camera loss, and clear it at reset.
architecture.continuation: When adding the 33 anchor inputs, extend both PPO first layers with zero weights, preserving the initial actor's behavior. Start the optimizer for the expanded shapes with no moments.
architecture.wrist_target_lead_rule: Project the neural rotation target toward a ball around the observed palm. Limit each correction to 0.08 rad relative to the previous target.

simulator.evaluator: CPU MuJoCo 3.17, frozen contract v3 suite

reward_terms.name: approach_progress
reward_terms.formula: Potential decrease of wrist and opposing-pad pose error before grasp

reward_terms.name: opposition
reward_terms.formula: One-time qualifying thumb and opposing-contact grasp At most once per episode across retries.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Increased unsupported centre rise while opposed, capped at 35 mm Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: Opposed lift above 15 mm for 0.10 s At most once per episode across retries.

reward_terms.name: reference_progress
reward_terms.formula: Sequential per-episode demonstration pose waypoints, opposed with active fingers Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: wrist_reference
reward_terms.formula: Palm position and orientation potential toward the selected reference

reward_terms.name: active_rotation
reward_terms.formula: Pay for episode-best combined blade elevation and relative rotation while unsupported, opposed and actively moving the fingers.

reward_terms.name: passive_rotation
reward_terms.formula: Variation of relative orientation under opposed contact with nearly stationary fingers

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: Completes at least 50 degrees of wrist-relative turn while opposed with blades within 20 degrees of up At most once per episode across retries.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in left-goal distance weighted by blade elevation under opposed contact Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: place_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in upright standing-height and blade-axis errors inside goal with hand contact Also guide the centre toward the target XY. Carry advances to descent at least 15 mm inside the zone. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: support_transfer
reward_terms.formula: First table support with hand contact following the turn and carried goal entry At most once per episode across retries. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: After controlled support transfer, stable upright table support with hand contact released At most once per episode across retries. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: durable_goal
reward_terms.formula: Maintains terminal goal for 0.5 s, penalty for subsequent disturbance Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Loses the opposed airborne plug before support Also penalize and reset the grasp attempt if the transport returns to support before entry or loses opposition for two steps.

reward_terms.name: time_and_control
reward_terms.formula: Living cost, small action term, hand/table cost, and safety penalty

reward_terms.name: leftward_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed decrease in distance to goal y during opposed unsupported turn and carry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: settling_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in object speed during supported hand contact following carried entry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: hand_clearance
reward_terms.formula: Increase in distance from the nearest pad after supported release. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: recontact
reward_terms.formula: Hand recontacts the supported upright plug following the first opening.

reward_terms.name: terminal_goal
reward_terms.formula: At the training horizon, the released plug still meets the resting goal over the last 0.5 s. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: load_transfer_progress
reward_terms.formula: Pay episode-best progress in an upright handover inside the zone and within 65 mm of standing height while touching the plug. The potential multiplies upright alignment by 0.35 standing-height progress, 0.25 low object velocity and spin, and 0.40 vertical table load saturated at 0.85 plug weights.

reward_terms.name: quiet_loaded_support
reward_terms.formula: One bonus after two consecutive 30 Hz samples with continuous table support, hand contact, tilt <= 15 degrees, speed < 0.06 m/s, spin < 1.5 rad/s, and vertical load >= 0.55 plug weights.

body.reflection: The first smaller-rate continuation yields 55 exact clean starts out of 64, all hardware, stop and state-log checks clear. It preserves early acquisition and underperforms its 58/64 parent on the same development set. Continue scoring through its allocated cap.

body.text: The r0424 excursion is visible in 1 ms evaluator maxima, while the original shaping samples risk only at 30 Hz. Keep the same risk curve, penalty, action bounds and PPO settings as the r0427 finger reward branch, but take the maximum over all physics substeps before each policy reward update. The monitor matches synthetic retreating and approaching states, accumulated maxima, reset and the 20 mrad termination boundary. On 38 dry starts, mean return is +43.226 physical plan, -0.790 hold and -0.971 random, with ten physical terminal successes and no physical-plan stops or violations. Allocate 6M steps from r0402 at 0.00006. Predict fewer worst-step finger excursions while preserving exact completions.

body.reflection: Independent safety audit of the accepted 166.03M PPO package on two new sets of 128 randomized deployment starts and sensor seeds. There are 244 exact completions, 245 staged placements, one measured joint-limit violation and one state-log error in a separate unsuccessful episode. No stops. Per-episode worst joint excursion has median 0.00343 rad, p99 0.00665 and max 0.02208. The gate excursion is reproduced as a rare class on an independent start. This evaluation informs further training; final starts are not used.

body.text: Independent audit r0434 completes 244/256 exact. Seed 1528112427 reproduces a middle-PIP lower excursion of 0.022085 rad at 3.811 s, and 1965986294 reaches 0.015170 rad beyond the same joint's upper bound at 2.223 s. In the first replay, middle and pinky fingertips contact through 3.711 s. With the -0.1247 Nm saturated actuator, middle PIP velocity reaches -30.73 rad/s by 3.791 s. At 3.801 s the actuator applies +0.1247 Nm, with only 0.242 rad left to the stop and velocity -29.42 rad/s. The filtered target is -0.278 rad at the crossing. The other replay reaches the upper stop after upper flexion accelerates from a constrained grasp. These support earlier speed-dependent braking margin in the training reward. Use 400 rad/s^2 as a conservative shaping estimate relative to the roughly 500 rad/s^2 braking seen in both traces, and keep it out of the policy interface and evaluator.

body.reflection: On 128 independent matched starts, the bounded-lead actor completes 109 exact sequences with no measured violations, stops or state-log errors. The selected parent's performance on the same starts is 123/128. This result leaves insufficient evidence of improved task success despite clean execution.

body.text: Extend r0431's substep risk by an early braking term using r0435's measured free-flight finger accelerations. Estimate braking distance as v²/(2×400 rad/s²), compare it to the margin in the direction of motion with 10 mrad extra, and scale the 120 mrad deficit by speed between 5 and 17 rad/s. Keep the same reward weight and violation threshold. On 38 dry starts mean returns are +43.865 physical, -0.790 hold, and -0.986 random. Physical plans incur zero mean risk cost and complete 11 terminals without violations or stops. Allocate 6M steps from r0402 on GPU 1 after its finger-margin reward comparison, with exports every 1.5M. Predict earlier braking and preserved task completion under the same frozen v4 evaluator.

reward_terms.name: recontact

body.reflection: First reduced-exploration checkpoint has 64 lifts, 64 turns and 58 exact completions of 64. It matches the parent's exact count with no measured violations, stops or state-log errors. Continue scoring the allocated comparison.

body.text: The independent r0434 audit lifts on all 256 starts and turns on 253. Eight turned trials miss carry/release. In final gate r0424 the two reviewed carry/release failures finish upright, confirming the endpoint is an insufficient learning signal. Compare an additional one-time 10-point reward for half a second of upright hands-off rest after the strict carry and support trace. The matched v4 dry check gives 48.993 for physical plans, -0.790 for hold, and -0.907 for random. Thirteen physical plan terminals hold and there are no physical violations or stops. Use 6M steps from r0402 at the same 0.00006 learning rate and known interface. Predict more uninterrupted supported transfers.

body.text: r0435 shows that a delayed finger target can remain well separated from the measured finger while contact blocks it, then release into a rapid motion. The existing 20-channel HandResponse feature summarizes the signed difference between measured encoders and a contract-only delayed 2 Hz target estimate. It uses past observed targets and no forces, measured velocities, time key or simulator state. CPU/Torch behavior and contract validation were checked for r0304. Use a matched 6M continuation from the r0402 actor at 0.00006 on GPU 3 with only those encoder response features added. Pad their first-layer weights and optimizer moments with zeros, preserving the starting action function. Predict fewer excursions and better active release from constrained fingertips.

body.text: The r0453 torque halt comes from a 50.16 N palm contact during descent. Continue from r0445's 167.58M substep-risk actor with the same 0.00006 learning rate, adding one quadratic term on the largest magnitude of the existing 30 ms filtered external arm moment. It starts at 12 Nm and saturates at 18 Nm with weight -0.06. The 20 Nm stop is unchanged. Dry average returns across 38 states are +44.218 physical, -0.790 hold and -0.972 random; the verified physical motion pays zero average arm-margin cost and has 12 terminal successes with no faults. Reserve 6M additional steps, with full CPU development evaluations every 1.5M. Predict fewer loaded palm contacts during placement.

body.text: The baseline PPO physics randomization is broad, while paired verification uses a calibrated nominal physics instance with varied starts and sensors. Test whether additional experience near the nominal actuator, friction and support parameters reduces end-to-end timing errors while retaining broad variation. From r0402 allocate 6M matched PPO steps with a 35% nominal-physics reset group and the original uniform ranges in the remaining 65%. Start poses and pose sensor randomness still vary in both groups. In a 128-world implementation check, 37 drew the nominal group and matched expected grip effort, finger delay and arm filter; the others span the intended mass range. Keep 0.00006 learning rate and verify under unchanged task v4.

body.text: The r0416 and r0424 reviewed traces keep the placed plug upright and hands off, but the arm continues moving. Across retained r0402 logs, palm y range from 10 to 60 s reaches 0.297 m while angular speed p95 can stay below 0.37 rad/s. A position and orientation anchor after a qualified release and half a second of rest targets this slow drift more directly than a high speed penalty. Charge at most 0.002 per step at equal 0.10 m and 0.50 rad scales. In the 38-start dry check physical return is +41.754, hold -0.790 and random -0.907. The physical plan settles eight times without a fault and mean added cost is -0.01345. Allocate a matched 6M steps from r0402 at 0.00006 on GPU 3. Predict fewer post-release arm excursions with the same ordered task behavior.

reward_terms.name: leftward_progress

reward_terms.name: settling_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in object speed during supported hand contact following carried entry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: hand_clearance
reward_terms.formula: Increase in distance from the nearest pad after supported release. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: recontact
reward_terms.formula: Hand recontacts the supported upright plug following the first opening.

reward_terms.name: terminal_goal
reward_terms.formula: At the training horizon, the released plug still meets the resting goal over the last 0.5 s. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: substep_finger_limit_risk
reward_terms.formula: Take the maximum over all 20 joints and all 1 ms substeps of the 30 Hz interval. The per-joint risk is the larger of the 5–20 mrad overshoot ramp and the product of proximity within 35 mrad and toward-limit speed scaled from 5 to 17 rad/s. A first actual violation adds a terminal penalty of 4. Also compare to a stopping distance v²/(2a) with a = 400 rad/s². Subtract the margin in the direction of motion, add 10 mrad, and ramp the resulting shortfall over 120 mrad. Weight by the same 5–17 rad/s speed ramp.

reward_terms.name: load_transfer_progress
reward_terms.formula: Pay episode-best progress in an upright handover inside the zone and within 65 mm of standing height while touching the plug. The potential multiplies upright alignment by 0.35 standing-height progress, 0.25 low object velocity and spin, and 0.40 vertical table load saturated at 0.85 plug weights.

reward_terms.name: quiet_loaded_support
reward_terms.formula: One bonus after two consecutive 30 Hz samples with continuous table support, hand contact, tilt <= 15 degrees, speed < 0.06 m/s, spin < 1.5 rad/s, and vertical load >= 0.55 plug weights.

body.reflection: The exact-transfer bonus at 169.14M moves from four to 53 exact successes of 64, clearing all physical and state checks. Maximum finger excursion is 0.01744 rad and four turned episodes miss continuous transfer. The terminal export already matches the parent's exact count.

body.text: Compliance training at the 6M cap improves the 24-start 4 ms diagnostic from 21 to 23 carry/releases and from one measured joint violation to zero. At 8 ms it gives 20 carry/releases and eight violations against the incumbent's 22 and five. At 20 ms both give violations on all 24, although the cap reduces worst excursion from 0.22295 to 0.09686 rad. Thus the 2–8 ms sampling did not establish robustness to the softer response. The 60 s frozen v4 cap has 58/64 exact, one stop, zero measured hardware violations and zero contract errors. Retain these as sensitivity results and keep training alternatives.

body.reflection: On 128 paired independent starts the braking-distance cap completes 115 exact, versus 121 for the incumbent. It has zero measured hardware violations and state-log errors, with one stop and maximum finger excursion of 0.01813 rad. Its nominal fixed set gain does not generalize to this cohort.

body.text: The 63/64 checkpoint r0480 has one reproducible error on failed-turn seed 8173543. Its peak commanded palm lead is 173 mm after 3.5 s but below 80 mm during initial acquisition. A local untrained action-map diagnostic caps desired translation to 85 mm from the measured palm and each resulting target increment to 70 mm. On a conditioned 16-start set it preserves all 15 former clean successes and clears the one contract state error, leaving the missed turn unchanged. NumPy and Torch action positions agree within 5.74e-8 m across 1,200 samples. Allocate 6M PPO steps at the same 0.00006 rate from r0480 with this single action change and the same 2–8 ms training compliance randomization. Predict tighter contract tracking with retained early success under frozen v4.

r0480 reaches 63/64 on the main set. Its independent paired audit gives 105/128 exact versus 121 for r0416, with two measured hardware violations and two state-log errors. Do not gate this export. The position-lead counterfactual isolates one diagnosed state error and the trained comparison proceeds on its fixed budget. Follow the gains in independent starts and safety rather than the first cohort.

body.text: The earlier matched critic comparison r0378 shows 417/3174 training full starts succeeding in a +9–12M window with asymmetric value inputs, against 64/3197 without. That branch's r0393 actor also completes 83/96 gate starts with zero hardware violations. To give this mechanism enough time after further PPO gains, allocate 12M from the stronger r0402 checkpoint at 0.00006 on GPU 0, with only the training value head expanded. The actor's weights, observation contract and action transform start unchanged. Export every 2M and judge nominal exact success and independent safety.

Replayed r0434 transfers use an occluded pose estimate at support. Five of eight controlled carry misses break support before opening, two cross the tilt limit, and one separates before support. The public kinematics features from r0367 supply finger-pad heights and positions derived from palm and hand encoders, with no estimated contact, object truth or force input. NumPy and Torch parity is within 9.54e-7 on the existing audit and the earlier smoke package validated. Allocate 6M matched PPO steps from r0402 at 0.00006 on GPU 2 with these 20 geometry channels as the only change. Zero-pad the new weights and moments to keep the initial policy behavior. Predict more exact supported release under occlusion.

body.text: Several PPO branches improve a checkpoint and regress in the next 1.5M steps, with rising state-log errors. Test inference with a 0.95 exponential parameter average of one continuously trained actor. Update the average once per PPO iteration, keep standard clipped PPO for data and optimization, and export only the averaged actor. Budget 12M steps from r0402 at the matched 0.00006 rate, export every 2M and score on frozen v4. https://papers.nips.cc/paper_files/paper/2022/hash/6ceb6c2150bbf46fd75528a6cd6be793-Abstract-Conference.html

reward_terms.formula: Pay for episode-best combined blade elevation and relative rotation while unsupported, opposed and actively moving the fingers.

reward_terms.name: passive_rotation
reward_terms.formula: Variation of relative orientation under opposed contact with nearly stationary fingers

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: Completes at least 50 degrees of wrist-relative turn while opposed with blades within 20 degrees of up At most once per episode across retries.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in left-goal distance weighted by blade elevation under opposed contact Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: place_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in upright standing-height and blade-axis errors inside goal with hand contact Also guide the centre toward the target XY. Carry advances to descent at least 15 mm inside the zone. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: support_transfer
reward_terms.formula: First table support with hand contact following the turn and carried goal entry At most once per episode across retries. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: After controlled support transfer, stable upright table support with hand contact released At most once per episode across retries. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: durable_goal
reward_terms.formula: Maintains terminal goal for 0.5 s, penalty for subsequent disturbance Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Loses the opposed airborne plug before support Also penalize and reset the grasp attempt if the transport returns to support before entry or loses opposition for two steps.

reward_terms.name: time_and_control
reward_terms.formula: Living cost, small action term, hand/table cost, and safety penalty

reward_terms.name: leftward_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed decrease in distance to goal y during opposed unsupported turn and carry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: settling_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in object speed during supported hand contact following carried entry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: hand_clearance
reward_terms.formula: Increase in distance from the nearest pad after supported release. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: recontact
reward_terms.formula: Hand recontacts the supported upright plug following the first opening.

reward_terms.name: terminal_goal
reward_terms.formula: At the training horizon, the released plug still meets the resting goal over the last 0.5 s. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: load_transfer_progress
reward_terms.formula: Pay episode-best progress in an upright handover inside the zone and within 65 mm of standing height while touching the plug. The potential multiplies upright alignment by 0.35 standing-height progress, 0.25 low object velocity and spin, and 0.40 vertical table load saturated at 0.85 plug weights.

reward_terms.name: quiet_loaded_support
reward_terms.formula: One bonus after two consecutive 30 Hz samples with continuous table support, hand contact, tilt <= 15 degrees, speed < 0.06 m/s, spin < 1.5 rad/s, and vertical load >= 0.55 plug weights.

body.reflection: At 172.24M the torque-margin branch has 56 carry/releases and 47 planned stages through placement, but one exact clean result. Sixteen measured hardware violations, ten stops and 63 state-log error episodes. This checkpoint is unsuitable for a task gate.

body.text: The broad 2–8 ms compliance range generated 485 training violation episodes in its last 2,702 resets over 32 PPO iterations, while the matched nominal-limit baseline had seven over 2,474. The cap improves the 4 ms diagnostic, but generalizes poorly at 8 ms and no better at 20 ms. For a less severe training distribution, reserve a 12M continuation from r0402 with finger-stop timing uniform from 2 to 4 ms. Retain the same reward, 0.00006 PPO rate, actor contract and other randomization. Predict better nominal task performance and modest compliance robustness. Use the fixed evaluator and 2M export intervals.
